items.docs: Returns the investments that meet the conditions defined in the `queries` object. Returns `performanceId` by default and any other data points specified in the `dataPoints` array.

info.name: Get securites and associated data points

params.name: startIndex
params.description: Row to start query from. Zero-based index; first row is '0.'

params.name: securityType
params.description: Unique identifier of a security type

params.name: results
params.description: Maximum number of rows to return

params.name: langcult
params.description: Language and locale, for example, en-US

params.name: securityDataPoints
params.description: Unique identifier of a data point. Can be data point ID or short ID. Multiple values must be pipe-separated.

params.name: filters
params.description: Data point ID with either min/max values, or a list of specific values. Multiple criteria must be comma-separated.

items.docs: Specify search and filter criteria to limit the number of results returned. You can define the format of the returned content - JSON or XML. </br></br>To override the default value in the Accept-Language HTTP header, use the `langcult` parameter.
